new_episode_events: Shake proposes taking a cutting to create labor; K.K. independently refuses. This conversation establishes no cloning or reliable vegetative reproduction mechanism.

Chris reports the already-born K.K. through the existing banjo channel to exterior Billy and listeners. K.K. physically compresses through a doorway, then exits via Billy-authorized actual mouth egress. No teleportation, new born identity or exterior Chris. Dana and Mana subsequently exit by actual Billy permission and egress.

K.K. meets Kaze, Arthur, Daniel and exterior Billy, experiences sunlight, establishes and withdraws small roots in local soil, sees an already-present distant serpent section, and chooses to walk with the group. No Sin admission occurs.

TPP leaves Sava clinic with Clifford's genuine assisted walking preserved and the wheelchair, helmet and cape retained. Coon/Cartman proposes a fake hero event, Clifford refuses, and Jimmy/Timmy/Cartman choose to return to HQ rather than attend the adult transaction.

Dutch uses the stolen harbor ledger to identify reachable freight broker Pell. Pell verifies relevant diverted-shipment information against his own notice and pays sixty silver for the book. Brian implies further access; Pell interprets that as a continuing threat and attempts armed coercion. No actual extra records or access granted by Brian's claim.

Clifford fires one revolver round into the wrist of the man drawing a pistol at the rear door. That man remains alive and wounded; his pistol falls. Dutch draws his own gun but does not fire. Tracy shoves the hatchet-carrying man into the rack and withdraws with the money and conjoined Brian.

Kaze, attracted by Dutch's audible voice while at a nearby garden stall, stands at the courtyard gate. The hatchet man uses another passage, mistakes K.K.'s moving wooden arm for an obstruction, wounds his forearm and attacks again. K.K. creates a real anatomical gap around the second blow, closes wood around the hatchet, then grabs and deliberately crushes the man's head after the attacker punches his wound. One new unnamed adult dead; no automatic execution or unearned immunity.

Arthur deters Pell's escape at the window with his visible position and hand on an UNSHAKEN grip; no shot. Dutch takes the same ledger back. Clifford sees Arthur, retains his grudge, and chooses to leave instead of beginning another fight. Arthur, Kaze and Chris now observe his assisted walking/apparatus through their actual views; no automatic medical knowledge.

Tracy voluntarily supplies one of the new sixty silver at Dutch's request, despite correcting the Busta misidentification angrily. Dutch gives it to K.K. TPP departs and returns to HQ with fifty-nine newly obtained silver and the original ledger. Old cash is separate and unspecified; old rent and medical debts are not paid by this episode.

K.K. explicitly recognizes that he could have released his victim. Kaze recognizes the impulse without declaring it right. K.K. challenges Kaze's choice to watch, and Kaze concedes the criticism. Dana offers practical help without becoming a compulsory commander. The garden seller supplies a cloth; K.K. wraps his wounded forearm. No automatic healing completion.

K.K. spends his one silver on a small ordinary pear tree and its tub, listens to its care needs, and chooses to remain exterior in the sunlight as the group leaves inland. The original plain walking stick remains his. The hatchet is released from his body and left at the scene; the corpse is not swallowed.

A surviving Pell employee runs toward the local guard post. Receipt of the report, arrests, retaliation and distant knowledge remain unperformed. TPP reaches HQ, where the children have returned; Cartman tries to claim credit, Timmy and Jimmy retain agency, Tracy prioritizes obligations, and Dutch counts their new funds.
